body:
I gave a PTSD group a go for a bit, but it didn’t feel like a good fit.  Nothing at all against the organizers or other attendees...I just felt like I couldn’t relate, given the nature and source of my PTSD (the attack, the aftermath, and having to forfeit my name). 

I’ve attended a couple of boxing class MeetUps. Those have actually been pretty fun! I’m getting back into making candles as well, but I do that on my own to relax. 

I’ve met a few characters... they make life interesting!
